column1: # *** 1. DON LUIS LERENA WAS DEAD BY 1895. *** Justiniana is entered VIUDA at 73. This archive knew
# only that he was alive in 1850 and dead by his son's death act of 1901. The window closes to
# 1850-1895, and she was a widow for at least the last thirteen years of her long life.
# *** 2. GILBERTO WAS A CORREDOR DE COMERCIO - a commercial broker. *** This archive has had him as a
# breeder and co-founder of the Argentine Stud Book, which is what he is remembered for. At 41, in
# his own house, he gave the enumerator a trade: broker. The horses were the other half of the life.
# *** 3. IT RESOLVES A CONTRADICTION THIS ARCHIVE FLAGGED AGAINST ITSELF. *** The register carried
# "Maria E. C. Lerena, b.1869, daughter of Gilberto (1854)" - which would have made him FIFTEEN, and
# was flagged on 13 September as a row that could not be right. The schedule shows her SOLTERA at 26,
# in a household that also contains JOSEFA, a widow of 43. *** She is not Gilberto's daughter. *** She
# is far more likely Josefa's daughter or Gilberto's sister. The census says only that she was in the
# house; "daughter" was this archive's reading of a household, and it was wrong.
# *** JOSEFA - "LERENA DE L[ERENA]", A WIDOW OF 43, URUGUAYAN. ***
# She is almost certainly the JOSEFA LERENA who stood godmother to Gilberto's son Raul at the
# Catedral de Montevideo in 1885 - a woman this archive met ten days into the search and could not
# place. Born about 1852, she is of Gilberto's own generation.
# *** AND THE FORM OF HER NAME IS "LERENA DE LERENA". *** On lines 2 and 3 the enumerator writes
# married women as [maiden surname] "de L." - Lenguas de Lerena, Salvanach de Lerena. On line 4 he
# writes LERENA de L. If he is consistent, she was BORN A LERENA AND MARRIED A LERENA.
# *** THAT IS EXACTLY THE PATTERN THIS ARCHIVE HAS BEEN LOOKING FOR. *** Pablo Armando's enrolment
# card names his parents JUAN CARLOS LERENA and MARIA LERENA - and the standing question is whether
# Maria was a Lerena by birth, which would make theirs a marriage between kin. A Lerena-Lerena
# marriage in this very family, one generation earlier, would show the pattern exists.
# *** STATED AS A READING, NOT A FACT. *** "de L." is an abbreviation and the enumerator's hand is
# not a marriage act. Josefa's own marriage record would settle it, and has not been looked for.
# *** THE AGES ON LINES 10-13 WERE READ AGAIN ON 20 SEPTEMBER, AND ONE OF THEM WAS WRONG. ***
# This file gave them as "6, 6, 5, 2". *** MARIA A. IS EIGHT, NOT SIX *** - read off the image at
# magnification, film 004149111 image 8. The four are *** 8, 6, 5, 2. ***
# *** AND THAT ONE DIGIT SETTLED TWO IDENTIFICATIONS THE REGISTER HAD BEEN HOLDING APART. ***
#   MARIA A., eight in 1895, is *** MARIA ANGELICA JULIA LERENA SALVANACH ***, baptised at San
#   Francisco de Asis on 31 October 1886 - which makes her eight. At six she could not have been.
#   MARIA C., six, is *** MARIA CARLOTA LERENA SALVANACH ***, baptised 29 October 1890 at about a
#   year old, and her nacion column reads ARGENTINA - "the first of the household born in Argentina",
#   which is what her baptism row has always claimed for her.
#   LUIS F., two, is *** LUIS FELIPE ***, baptised 30 December 1892. Merged the same day.
# *** THE ENUMERATOR WROTE INITIALS AND THE PRIEST WROTE NAMES, *** and this archive held four of
# these children twice over because it read both and never laid them side by side.
